verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal lists webhooks as part of its API surface, alongside OAuth client-credentials and expense endpoints [navan-docs-2]. That is a first-party claim, but it is a single bare mention with no detail on how to register a callback or which events are emitted. The async-job polling mentioned elsewhere is a different mechanism and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription flow, list of subscribable event types, payload/signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
